messages:
sara-sales: Hey team — Argenta POC is stuck. CISO wants answers to a security questionnaire and a BYO-KMS path before exec signoff. Also asking for committed pricing tiers. Can we triage?
alan-se: Thanks for the ping. Do we have the questionnaire PDF? I can map answers to our architecture.
sara-sales: Uploaded the form here: https://acme-share/argenta-sec-q.pdf — primary asks: KMS BYO, egress residency, and an SLA for 99.9% p99 latency under their workload.
eva-eng: FYI their sample QPS is ~1200 concurrent streams with avg seq len 512 — we should confirm model variant and batching.
mike-ops: For BYO-KMS we need customer IAM thumbprint + peering details. Also need to confirm if they want private (VPC) vs hosted with allowlist.
natasha-ciso: @sara-sales can you extract the specific encryption questions? We typically answer with our KMS integration matrix, but BYO adds attestation asks.
sara-sales: Copying the encryption section into thread: 
```
Q: Can you support customer-managed keys (BYO-KMS)? If so, describe key lifecycle, rotation, and access controls.
Q: Do you allow encryption in transit and at rest? Provide certs and attestation.
Q: Where are audit logs stored and retention?
```
alan-se: Quick draft answers: yes for BYO-KMS for Private + Dedicated; key lifecycle handled via external KMS; rotation is customer-managed; access via confined service account and no plaintext keys on hosts. Audit logs pushed to customer log sink for Private. I can polish.
natasha-ciso: That aligns. But Argenta asked for an HSM attestation doc and proof of separation of crypto keys from our control plane. We'll need Legal + Infra signoff.
liz-legal: I can draft the attestation addendum, but need the technical artifact from infra/eng describing where keys live and how KMS endpoints are proxied. @eva-eng / @mike-ops can you provide a short diagram?
eva-eng: Will drop a minimal network diagram and a sample config. Example allowlist snippet below:
```yaml
redwood_private: true
vpc_peering: true
kms_endpoint: "kms.us-east-1.argenta.example"
allowed_ip_blocks: ["10.32.0.0/16"]
```
alan-se: Also they asked about rollback/fallback: propose automatic fallback to a verified hosted key variant if KMS endpoint unreachable for >30s, with telemetry flagged. Need product approval.
sara-sales: Argenta also pushed on pricing: they want committed spend discount + a path to a lower per-token rate if sustained qps > 1k. Can Finance give a ballpark?
deploy-bot: New exec-bridge created: #exec-argenta-5pm-bridge. Meeting scheduled 2026-05-14 17:00 UTC.
mike-ops: From ops POV we can support the throughput on Dedicated with a reserved pool. Need Finance to confirm discount tiers, and Security to sign the attestation.
liz-legal: I'll start a DRAFT addendum and share in the drive. Need the infra diagram and the exact SLA wording (latency SLO vs contractual SLA).
natasha-ciso: If we promise 99.9% p99 latency we must lock model family and instance types. Recommend we propose a canary SLA: 99.9% on Dedicated pinned config, fallback to best-effort on Hosted.
sara-sales: Can we table a concrete proposal for the exec bridge? Action items: 1) Alan — finalize sec answers + fallback text. 2) Eva/Mike — infra diagram + config snippet. 3) Liz — draft attestation addendum. 4) Finance (cc @trevor-fin) — pricing tiers draft.
alan-se: I'll have sec answers + fallback by EOD.
eva-eng: Diagram + config in drive by EOD.
mike-ops: Ops-runbook entry for BYO-KMS + failover steps in PR. ETA tomorrow morning.
liz-legal: Addendum first pass by tomorrow midday.
sara-sales: Great — I'll prep the exec deck for the 5pm bridge. Please @mention any blockers. :thumbsup:
natasha-ciso: One more ask: audit log retention must be configurable to 7 years for them. Confirm whether Private supports that retention window.
eva-eng: We can push logs to customer GCS/S3 for arbitrary retention. I'll note the operational cost.
sara-sales: Perfect. If we can hit these items, we should be able to remove the blocker and get signoff. Thanks everyone.
alan-se: Quick note for the record — don't promise auto-fallback without a feature flag; ops needs toggle.
mike-ops: Agreed, I'll add flagging + metrics (kms.failover_count) to the PR.
sara-sales: Closing loop — will update after the deck and bridge. :pray:
